keyEvents.text: Goal! Racing de Santander 0, Real Madrid 1. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Racing de Santander 0, Real Madrid 2. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Arda Güler with a through ball.
Delay in match because of an injury Álvaro Mantilla (Racing de Santander).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Racing de Santander. Pedro Felipe replaces Álvaro Mantilla because of an injury.
Jeanuël Belocian (Racing de Santander) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Racing de Santander 0, Real Madrid 3. Yan Diomande (Real Madrid) right footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner following a corner.
Iker Luque (Racing de Santander) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Racing de Santander 0, Real Madrid 3.
Substitution, Racing de Santander. Íñigo Sainz-Maza replaces Pablo Ramón.
Substitution, Racing de Santander. Pablo García replaces Yassir Zabiri.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Brahim Díaz replaces Arda Güler.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Eduardo Camavinga replaces Bernardo Silva.
Substitution, Racing de Santander. Giorgi Guliashvili replaces Iñigo Vicente.
Substitution, Racing de Santander. André Almeida replaces Iván Martín.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Endrick replaces Yan Diomande.
Second Half ends, Racing de Santander 0, Real Madrid 3.
